title: add jsonschema strict-mode: improved validation errors and OpenAI-compat response_format
author: Ava Kim
description:
Motivation: strengthen JSON Schema-based structured output support for response_format with a strict mode and clearer validation errors, while maintaining OpenAI compatibility. This PR extends the response_format API to support the `strict` flag (boolean) and improves validator error messages so callers can programmatically surface validation failures. It also adds compatibility mappings for legacy OpenAI-style response_format objects and ships unit/integration tests plus docs/examples.

Scope: 
- API: parse and normalize response_format (OpenAI and Redwood shapes), expose `strict` semantics.
- Runtime: run schema validation after generation and return structured validation errors (differentiating schema mismatch vs malformed JSON).
- Error handling: stable, typed error shapes that the OpenAI-compat layer can translate to 'content_policy' style or the new `response_format_error` key.
- Tests & docs: unit tests for validator, integration test with streaming path, docs + examples in redwood-docs.

Checklist: 
- [x] response_format parsing + normalization
- [x] strict-mode validation and opt-out semantics
- [x] improved validation error payloads and logging hooks
- [x] OpenAI-compat mappings for legacy response_format shapes
- [x] unit + integration tests (validator edge-cases, streaming fallback)
- [x] docs and changelog entry

Notes: The change intentionally does not alter default behavior (strict defaults to false). In strict mode we enforce that the final model output parses as JSON and validates against the schema; violations result in a 400-ish structured API error when used via the Redwood hosted API, and in the SDKs we surface a typed exception. For streaming we add an early-close signal and a final validation summary event to maintain compatibility with existing streaming consumers. Related Linear: ENG-9172, ENG-9211. Related Jira: SUP-4312 (customer reported unclear schema errors).
commits: feat(jsonschema): add strict-mode handling and validator error shapes; feat(api): normalize OpenAI-style response_format to canonical shape; fix(tests): handle streaming path validation; docs: add structured-output examples; tests: add regression cases for escaped JSON output

review_comments: Diego Martinez: Nice work. A couple of requests: 1) make sure the public API error shape is stable (don't expose internal validator paths directly), 2) include a clear example in the docs that shows the streaming 'validation_summary' event. Requested changes: adjust error field names and add example for nested schema path formatting.
Ava Kim (author): Addressed Diego's feedback — added a 'location' field with JSON Pointer format and a 'hint' field for common fixes. Updated docs with streaming example. PTAL.
Priya Nair: Please add a guard to avoid double-validation when a downstream filter already enforces schema (we've seen duplicated costs). Consider a flag to short-circuit.
Ava Kim (author): Added 'skip_validation_if_tagged' option on RequestMetadata and a runtime fast-path to short-circuit. Tests added covering short-circuit path.
Ethan Zhang: Approved after minor nits. Verified tests and CI.
release_notes: Add `response_format.strict` boolean for JSON Schema strict validation. Improved schema validation error messages (location as JSON Pointer and hint field). OpenAI-compat mappings for legacy response_format objects included. Streaming now emits a final 'validation_summary' event when strict validation is enabled.
merge_summary: Merged with squash. Includes API change (response_format strict flag, new error shape) but defaults preserve existing behavior. Docs and SDK examples updated to demonstrate strict mode and streaming validation summary.
